crossRefs.note: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.
If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.

translations.web: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.
translations.bsb: Let him stay with you as a hired worker or temporary resident; he is to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.
translations.kjv: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:
translations.asv: As a hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee; he shall serve with thee unto the year of jubilee:
